author: Kusha N M
raw:
ತಿಳಿದಿಲ್ಲ ನಮಗೆಂದು ಹಿಂದುಮುಂದಿನ ಜನುಮ
ಗಳಿಕೆಯಲಿ ಪಡೆದಿಹೆವು ನಾವಿರುವ ಹುಟ್ಟು
ಅಳಿಯುವುದು ಉಳಿಯುವುದು ಜೀವಚಕ್ರದ ಸತ್ಯ
ತಿಳಿದುನಡೆ ಜೀವನವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: We do not know our past and future births;
we have received the birth we have as an earning;
perishing and remaining is the truth of the wheel of life;
know this and walk through life, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We know nothing of past or future lives; this life is what we have earned. Coming and going is the nature of existence. Understanding this, live wisely.
